start_pose.description: Half-kneeling lunge: right knee on the pad, left foot forward with the left knee over the ankle (hip 90, knee 90), torso tall, hands on the front thigh, pelvis neutral.
start_pose.implement: pad under back knee

phases.name: tuck
phases.description: Exhale, tuck the tailbone (posterior pelvic tilt ~ 15 deg) and engage the glute of the back leg.
phases.implement_path: ribs knit, no lumbar arch

phases.name: shift_forward
phases.description: Shift the pelvis forward until a stretch is felt at the front of the right hip (back hip extension ~ -15 to -20).
phases.implement_path: pelvis moves ~ 8-10 cm forward

phases.name: hold
phases.description: Hold 20-30 s, optionally reach the right arm overhead and bend slightly sideways to the left.

phases.name: release
phases.description: Return to start and switch sides.

cues: Stretch comes from tucking, not leaning

mistakes.mistake: Front knee travels past toes excessively

specs.safety: Pad the knee; avoid with knee pain; stretch gently.
specs.regression: Standing lunge stretch, smaller range.
specs.progression: Add arm reach, rotation, or couch stretch.

names.tr: Foam Roller ile Sırt (Upper Back Roll)

specs.equipment_setup: Standard foam roller ~ 15 cm diameter x 90 cm long placed horizontally (perpendicular to the spine) under the upper back at shoulder-blade level; knees bent, feet flat hip-width, hips lifted slightly or on the mat; hands behind the head supporting the neck.

camera.why: side shows the roller position and roll range; 3/4 shows elbows open

start_pose.description: Supine with the foam roller across the upper back below the shoulder blades, knees bent ~ 90 and feet flat, hips lifted off the mat in a small bridge (or on the mat), hands interlaced behind the head, elbows wide, chin slightly nodded. Angle note: in lying/curled supine positions, hip_flexion/hip_flexion_L/R values describe leg elevation from the mat (leg_height_from_mat) unless the pose is seated; torso curl is given separately by thoracic_flexion/lumbar_flexion/head_neck_flexion; pelvis_tilt_deg: 0 neutral, + posterior tilt (imprint ~5-10, full posterior tilt ~15-20), - anterior.
start_pose.implement: roller under the mid-thoracic spine, 10-15 cm below the neck

phases.name: roll_up_the_back
phases.description: Push through the feet and roll the roller up toward the shoulder blades/upper back, pausing to extend gently over the roller.
phases.implement_path: travel ~ 10 cm up from mid-back to upper back

phases.name: roll_down_the_back
phases.description: Roll back down toward the mid-back, small controlled movement.
phases.implement_path: avoid rolling onto the lower back

cues: Support the neck with the hands
Keep the abs engaged, ribs knit

mistakes.fix: stay above the bra line, brace abs
keep chin nodded, hands supporting head

specs.safety: Avoid rolling the neck or lumbar; avoid with osteoporosis or acute back pain; use gentle pressure.
specs.regression: Smaller roll, roller on a soft pad, hips on the mat.
specs.progression: Add arm reaches overhead, single-leg lift, over-extension.
